title: The anievent data structure
text: Two temporal kinds: State events — interval-valued, durative (stop > start). sleep bout, grooming bout. Point events — instantaneous (stop == start). startle, vocalisation onset. anievent class intentionally type-agnostic: require declare channels state point. channel column already names channels, duration row tells everything class needs. Type becomes load-bearing conversion / plotting / metric time: converting anievent per-frame aniframe (conversion knows whether fill whole interval just single frame), plotting (state → coloured band; point → marker), computing metrics differ type. operations live companion packages (animetric, anivis) accept type declarations call time. aniframe side distinction can recorded explicitly set_variables_event(state = ..., point = ...), anievent class enforce — anievent variables_event , since events already encoded channel label.
